CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[tMAN_Maintenance_UpdateTimeRoad] ON [dbo].[MAN_Equipment] 
--FOR 
AFTER UPDATE
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @cd_equipment INT,
		@ARRAY VARCHAR(MAX) = '', 
		@DELIMITADOR VARCHAR(MAX), 
		@ds_equipments varchar(max),
		@cd_road int,
		@cd_roadTime int,
		@TimeRoad int = 0,
		@count int = 0
BEGIN
		
		declare @d integer
		declare @i integer
		
		select @d = vl_empty_time from deleted
		select @i = vl_empty_time from inserted
							
		if (@d = @i) 
			BEGIN
				RETURN	
			END
			ELSE

			DECLARE db_Equipment CURSOR
			FAST_FORWARD
			FOR SELECT i.cd_equipment FROM INSERTED i

			-- Abre o cursor
			OPEN db_Equipment

			-- Lê o primeiro registro
			FETCH NEXT FROM db_Equipment INTO @cd_equipment

			-- Varre os demais registros
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN

						print 'Select ds_equipments, cd_road from TRA_Road where (ds_equipments like ''%,' + cast(@cd_equipment as varchar(10)) + ''' or ds_equipments like ''%,' + cast(@cd_equipment as varchar(10)) + ',%'' or ds_equipments like '''+ cast(@cd_equipment as varchar(10)) + ',%'' or ds_equipments = ''' + cast(@cd_equipment as varchar(10)) + ''')'

					DECLARE db_cursor CURSOR FOR  Select ds_equipments, cd_road from TRA_Road where (ds_equipments like '%,' + cast(@cd_equipment as varchar(10)) or ds_equipments like '%,'+ cast(@cd_equipment as varchar(10)) +',%' or ds_equipments like cast(@cd_equipment as varchar(10)) +',%'  or ds_equipments = cast(@cd_equipment as varchar(10)) )

					OPEN db_cursor   
					FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @ds_equipments, @cd_road

					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
					BEGIN 
					-- SETANDO O DELIMITADOR
						SELECT @DELIMITADOR = ','

							WHILE LEN(@ds_equipments) > 0
							BEGIN
				  
								-- VERIFICA DELIMITAFOR
								if CHARINDEX(@DELIMITADOR, @ds_equipments) > 0
								BEGIN
									--CRIA O ARRAY COM OS EQUIPAMENTOS
									SET @ARRAY = LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@ds_equipments, 1, CHARINDEX(@DELIMITADOR, @ds_equipments) - 1))	
									SET @ds_equipments = SUBSTRING(@ds_equipments, CHARINDEX(@DELIMITADOR, @ds_equipments) + 1, LEN(@ds_equipments))
						
									--ACRESCENTA TEMPOS DOS EQUIPMANTOS
									SET @TimeRoad = @TimeRoad + (select vl_empty_time from MAN_Equipment where cd_equipment = @ARRAY)
					
								--IDENTIFICA ROTAS QUE CONTEM O EQUIPAMENTO ALTERADO
									IF @ARRAY = @cd_equipment
									SET @cd_roadTime = @cd_road
								END
								ELSE

									BEGIN
									--ACRESCENTA TEMPOS DOS EQUIPMANTOS
									SET @ARRAY = @ds_equipments
									SET @TimeRoad = @TimeRoad + (select vl_empty_time from MAN_Equipment where cd_equipment = @ARRAY)
									set @ds_equipments = ''
					 
									--IDENTIFICA ROTAS QUE CONTEM O EQUIPAMENTO ALTERADO
									IF @ARRAY = @cd_equipment
									SET @cd_roadTime = @cd_road
									END
								END   
			
							--SE RETORNAR ROTA ATUALIZA TEMPO EM BASE AOS EQUIPAMENTOS VINCULADOS A MESMA
							IF @cd_roadTime > 0
								BEGIN
								SET @count += 1
									print 'road ' + cast(@cd_roadTime as varchar(10))	
									--print @cd_roadTime	
									print @count
									UPDATE TRA_ROAD SET vl_time_transport = @TimeRoad  WHERE CD_ROAD = @cd_roadTime
								END
			 
						FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @ds_equipments, @cd_road
						--RESET VARIAVEIS
						SET @TimeRoad = 0
						SET @cd_roadTime = 0

					END
					
					CLOSE db_cursor   
					DEALLOCATE db_cursor
					SET NOCOUNT OFF
				
		-- Passa para o próximo registro
        FETCH NEXT FROM db_Equipment INTO @cd_equipment
    END

    -- Fecha o cursor
    CLOSE db_Equipment
    -- Desaloca o cursor
    DEALLOCATE db_Equipment
END
